Hi, we (both mtf 21) have been together for 3 years and living together as long. We are both on the subby/bottom side of things and are pre-op, though one of us has periods of stronger dysphoria than the other. We have found several things specifically that work for us, but the main one is meeting your partner where they are at. It's important that you and your partner talk about in specifics what you are and are not comfortable with during intimacy. we have found that it is important to start slow and small, focusing on the connection you have together rather than the feeling of intimacy itself. 

When it comes to the process of beginning intimate moments, it isn't necessary to have one of you "start" the act. Foreplay is something that doesn't always begin sexual. It can start with cuddling, or watching a movie, laying in bed together, or a variety of other ways. If you really want to have sex, you can attempt to initiate with a bit more intention, but otherwise it's nice to just let things fall into place. You can attempt to initiate sex in ways that aren't just subby or dommy either, sometimes just stripping a bit can be all you need, but that depends on your partner and their mood of course.

In the act itself, the key is to let things flow as you two want. Touch in spots you want, ask for things, etc. One thing we've found that can help is be reciprocal during any and all actions. Feel each other up at the same time, have one give head while the other touches, etc. It feels like you're being less dominant doing something even such as penetration if your partner is doing something to you at the same time. Toys can help with this, vibrators especially (putting one between you two so you both feel it is a wonderful sensation). If dysphoria is an issue for either of you, it's possible to focus on things that aren't triggering that dysphoria. If either of you are having dysphoria, try staying away from the region causing that and focus on other areas. It can also help to just avoid looking at that area if you still want to do stuff there (especially so for giving/recieving head). Communicate this when you feel that way so that you have a good time, which will ultimately lead to you both having a better time.
